cover.hook: Same component. Two very different kinds of data.
items: When to use which in real projects

a.title: Props
a.sub: Read-only input · passed down by the parent
a.use: Configuring a component: labels, data and callbacks.
a.watch: Never mutate props. Ask the parent to change them.

b.title: State
b.sub: Owned by the component · changes over time
b.use: Data that changes: inputs, toggles and fetched results.
b.watch: count++ does nothing. Always call setCount.

rows: When the parent passes new props
compare.rule: Props come in. State lives here. If a child must change it, pass a callback down.

cta.headline: Props or {a}State{/a}?
cta.question: Which one trips you up most? Tell me why in the comments.
